scope: Completion of the original 154 missing-definition queue in the 210-row Toyota EXP002 dataset. Not all Toyota codes worldwide, and not full technical/OEM approval.
limitations: Most sources are manufacturer-document reproductions on third-party hosts; official hosting not authenticated.
A main-code definition cannot substitute for its INF-specific condition.
Other fields, model-year applicability and diagnostic/repair procedures still need full technical review.
Existing verification_status fields intentionally remain unchanged.
next_stage: Full technical review of Toyota; Honda definition review follows under the established brand order.
